notes.title: v2.4 "Prismatic"
notes.content:
Open Brush is 3 today! We're celebrating by releasing a new version, packed with tons of new features. We have an even bigger 3.0 release in the works which will add multiplayer, but we wanted to get these features to you as soon as possible!

[h2]Localization[/h2]
You can now use Open Brush in 7 languages:
[list]
[*] English
[*] French
[*] Spanish
[*] German
[*] Chinese
[*] Japanese
[*] Korean
[/list]

If you'd like to help add more languages then please [url=https://docs.openbrush.app/get-involved]get in touch[/url]!

[h2]Multi-Mirror[/h2]
The regular Mirror Tool is incredibly useful but for those of you who are interested in symmetry and geometric patterns, you'll find a lot to explore in the new Multi-Mirror Tool.
It supports dozens of types of symmetry and has powerful control of color variance for the replicated brush strokes.

[url=https://docs.openbrush.app/release-history/v2.4#multi-mirror][img]https://1839893864-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Mikdwm98p33AibfiSqN%2Fuploads%2FdwwTGlIwa5d3tkP2jDVl%2FUntitled_118_01.png?alt=media&token=98ccec6a-dfd6-4664-b725-8b1f40a3a8d9[/img][/url]

[h2]XR Keyboard[/h2]

Does your sketches folder contain hundreds of sketches called "Untitled"? No more!
Currently used for renaming sketches and setting the names of layers - having a built-in keyboard will allow many previously difficult features in the near future.

[url=https://docs.openbrush.app/release-history/v2.4#xr-keyboard][img]https://1839893864-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Mikdwm98p33AibfiSqN%2Fuploads%2FYJ0gg2YALR7IZToaKI68%2Fimage.png?alt=media&token=89af904e-15d1-40dc-8e78-387b6b2a0442[/img][/url]

[h2]Transform Panel[/h2]
The new Transform Panel adds some powerful tools to help with building complex scenes. Open Brush has traditionally been aimed at freehand drawing or painting but we've always wanted to improve workflows that require precise control over elements of your sketch.

[url=https://docs.openbrush.app/release-history/v2.4#transform-panel][img]https://1839893864-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Mikdwm98p33AibfiSqN%2Fuploads%2Fd9VxKqfNbvaNvafFEttj%2Fspaces_-Mikdwm98p33AibfiSqN_uploads_34pysXCimxhFsI0qpwNy_image.webp?alt=media&token=d56b228e-c440-4091-9278-e3ce1d422c51[/img][/url]

There's plenty more in this release, including support for 360 image backgrounds, a new glTF importer, and SVG importer! You can read the full patch notes here: [url=https://docs.openbrush.app/release-history/v2.4]https://docs.openbrush.app/release-history/v2.4[/url]

Happy Painting!

notes.title: New release:v2.2 - Settings and Sketches
notes.content:
[h2]Features[/h2]

[h3]Bundled "Featured Sketches"[/h3]
Since Google Poly closed down, the immediate access to some examples by talented artists was sorely missed.  So we've added some of the classics back in. We have big plans for sharing and viewing artwork so this is just the start.
[h3]Add a button in Setting to switch handedness[/h3]
Previously the only way to do this was to tap the bottom of the controllers together. This wasn't easy to discover and was unreliable when using some controllers.  We've kept that in but added a nice clear button the app settings.
[h3]Add a button in Setting to reset the "First Time Use" tutorial[/h3]
This is something that's especially useful when you want to demo Open Brush to a new user. The current tutorial is very brief but we hope to expand it in the future. Note this button affects the app the next time you launch it.

[h2]Known Issues[/h2]

[list]
[*] Meta Quest: Incorrect or missing video thumbnails are shown
[*] Meta Quest: Gif capture results in just a black image
[*] Meta Quest (Quest 1 only): Selection and erase tools are not working
[*] Valve Index Controllers: Grip is too sensitive. It's easy to accidentally trigger a grab when drawing.
[*] Issues with controllers not appearing when the wrong OpenXR runtime is selected. Vermillion has [url=https://vermillion-vr.com/support/]suggested some workarounds[/url]. (Thanks Vermillion!)
[/list]

​
​

notes.title: v2.1 Hotfix
notes.content:
2.1 is a bugfixes only release. We're looking forward to bringing new features to Open Brush soon!

[list]
[*] Enable WMR default controller profile.
[*] Fix saving after deleting a layer.
[*] Fix swapping camera modes when using a Vive controller.
[*] Smoother scrolling on Vive controller touchpads.
[*] Fix advanced tools panel overlapping other panels.
[/list]

Known Issues:
[list]
[*] Sometimes Open Brush fails to launch depending on the specific combinations of user's HMD, controller Type, and OpenXR runtime. We're working on methods to smooth over and resolve these issues, apologies if you're experiencing them! Please get in touch with us so we can help debug your setup.
[*] Can't swap controller handedness by tapping together.
[/list]

The following issues are pending a bug being fixed in Unity, which we found and reported.
[list]
[*] Controller issues with HP Reverb G2.
[*] Difficult to dismiss panels by throwing them away.
[*] Deadzone on WMR controller thumbsticks is too sensitive.
[/list]

notes.title: Open Brush v2.0 Update!
notes.content:
Open Brush v2.0 is finally here! This update marks our second anniversary, and the end of a long year of work to upgrade the project to the latest and greatest in XR tech.

Full release notes here!
https://docs.openbrush.app/release-history/2.0

Note: for those using the beta branches named:
prerelease
prerelease-experimental
beta-experimental

Please note these branches have been removed, as experimental mode is now part of the main build.
You will have been automatically moved back to the main release.
If you still want to try our beta builds as soon as they are available, please join the 'beta' branch.
